title: Film labs / research faculties and film production

commenti.body: Total Refusal immediately came to mind. Different production methods sure, but they’re all working towards the same end goal. This is how they describe themselves: Total Refusal is a pseudo-marxist media guerilla focused on the artistic intervention and appropriation of mainstream video games. We upcycle video games in order to reveal the political apparatus beyond the glossy and hyperreal textures of this media.
Really exciting. Hadn't heard of them. My friend has made a short film that takes place within the world of GTA, so I should also send it to them. Thank you!
